so one day U told me and my family we had to leave his property that was good and well but no 30 days to find a place no warning he just said we had to leave we ended up arguing a week out of U Or Course as a kid my stomach was in knots cause I didn’t know if we would keep living here or be homeless. A while through the week he found out about her terrible lies and broke up with her and told us the only reason he was trying to kick us out was because she wanted him to so he said we could stay (This Was A BIG Relief For Me As The Stress Had Given Me An Ulcer At This Point) But there was one problem. She Wouldn’t leave. After weeks of trying to get EGF to leave after her screaming at us across the yard calling us trash ect. We decided to file a restraining order against her we did it she FINALLY left.
